svg.text: WHO SELLS THE POOL

text.style: font-family:var(--font-inter, Inter), Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each community sells its own pool under its own rules, to whoever it chooses. Who is

text.style: font-family:var(--font-inter, Inter), Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: buying the sold beds is the first of the four gates, named per place before any bed

text.style: font-family:var(--font-inter, Inter), Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: moves. No community is named beside a price until it has seen the design.

text.style: font-family:var(--font-inter, Inter), Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every row is an invoice or a quote in Xero as at 5 September 2026. Bed requests are not counted here: no register exists, so the number would be ours and not a document.
